# ふりがな整備士 (Furigana Seibishi)

> iPhone/iPad app and information site for the written part of Japan's automotive mechanic exams (Automotive Maintenance Skill Registration Examination: grade 1 small vehicles, grade 2, grade 3). Questions stay in Japanese, with furigana on every kanji, an explanation for every choice, and AI-generated reference translations in English, Nepali, Chinese, Vietnamese, Indonesian, Sinhala and Burmese. Made by an individual with experience teaching exam-prep classes at a mechanic school. Not endorsed or supervised by JASPA. Does not guarantee passing.

Key facts (as of 2026-11-09):
- A single "comprehensive" (総合) written exam for grades 2 and 3 starts on 14 March 2027, with some earlier exam types still listed for that sitting (grade 2: 40 questions/80 min; grade 3: 30/60; applications 14-18 December 2026). Grade 1 from March 2028 at the earliest. Source: JASPA notice.
- No past comprehensive exam questions exist yet. The app re-organizes earlier past questions into the new fields and adds original practice questions written for the scope of the comprehensive exam, labeled as not real exam questions.
- Past questions: grade 2: 2,831; grade 3: 2,084; grade 1: 456 (content release 2026-11-06.4). JASPA replied in October 2026 that permission is not required to offer them with furigana, translations and explanations; this is not an endorsement.
- Free: one full practice set per grade. One-time purchase per grade: JPY 980 grade 3 / 1,500 grade 2 / 1,800 grade 1. No subscription, no account, offline, no personal data collected.
- iOS only (16.4+). Android in preparation with no date. Sinhala and Burmese are partial or missing for grade 2 body and electrical questions.
- App Store: https://apps.apple.com/jp/app/id6827350748
